Босвеллия.about: Indian Frankincense: Acids inhibit 5-LOX; pain and stiffness are lower with osteoarthritis.
Босвеллия.caution: Boswellia serrata - 'Indian incense'. For osteoarthritis: Aflapin standardized extract (38365549) shows improvement in pain/function. For inflammation: Inhibits 5-lipoxygenase (5-LOX), an alternative to NSAIDs. For asthma/IBD: limited data. There is little data (2 abstracts in the database). A standardized extract with ≥30% boswellic acids is required. Dose: 100-250 mg 2-3 times/day.
effects: Osteoarthritis pain: moderate, in MA comparable to NSAIDs
Босвеллия.food_sources: Non-food: Boswellia serrata (frankincense) resin; It is used as a supplement and cannot be obtained from food.
Босвеллия.guidelines: MA 2024 (9 RCT, 712): VAS and WOMAC pain −10.7, stiffness −5.5; Aflapin is stronger (−16.1 vs −4.7); AEs as placebo.
Босвеллия.how_to_choose: Extract with AKBA ≥30%, better standardized forms; 300-500 mg 2-3 times a day in a course.
mechs: Osteoarthritis pain: moderate, in MA comparable to NSAIDs
OA: VAS -10.7, WOMAC-pain and function -10.7 (9 RCT, 712 people)
Standardized forms are better than non-standardized ones
Aflapin is stronger than other extracts (VAS -16.1 vs -4.7); modified forms are the best WOMAC
Босвеллия.myths: “Treats asthma and IBD” - limited data, niche - joints. "All forms are the same" - Aflapin and modified forms are noticeably stronger.
Босвеллия.name: Boswellia
Босвеллия.onset: Symptomatic: Pain and function improve after weeks of taking the standardized extract.
Босвеллия.title: Boswellia
Босвеллия.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Босвеллия.who_needs: Joint osteoarthritis (pain, stiffness, function) as an alternative/addition to NSAIDs; according to AEs it is safe in NMA.
